article.sect1:
Executive SummaryExecutive Summary
Soralia Village is being transformed from a single-tenant community platform into NetComplex — a white-label SaaS platform hosting multiple community clients on one shared codebase. Soralia Village becomes the first and flagship tenant.
Key Finding: You Are Further Along Than the Original Plan Assumes
A repository audit found that significant multi-tenant groundwork is already in place.
The original plan's Immediate phase is largely complete. This updated guide reorients
around what is genuinely missing, not what has already been built.
What Already Exists in the RepoWhat Already Exists in the Repo
tenants.ts
Tenants table exists in Drizzle schema
organizations.ts
Better-Auth organizations + relations wired
features/registry.ts
Feature registry file already present in lib/features/
TenantProvider.tsx
Tenant context component in src/components/ui/
TenantStyles.tsx
CSS variable injection component in place
lib/tenant.ts
Tenant resolution library exists
admin/platform/
Super-admin tenant UI scaffolded at /admin/platform/[id]/features/
api/admin/platform/tenants/
Tenant management API route exists
Migration 20260331
organization_id backfilled to identity tables — active work underway

1. Architecture Overview1. Architecture Overview
The architecture follows a shared-codebase, shared-database model with strong tenant isolation enforced at the middleware and query layers.
Platform LayersPlatform Layers
NetComplex Platform
app.netbones.co.za — marketing, billing, super-admin
Tenant Instances
soralia.netbones.co.za or custom domains — isolated data + branding
Data Layer
Shared PostgreSQL via Drizzle, tenant_id / organization_id on all tables
Tenant Resolution
Middleware detects subdomain or custom domain, loads cached config
Theming
CSS variables injected at layout level for dynamic Tailwind colors + logos
Features
DB-backed toggles + component registry — tenants enable/disable modules
Tenant Resolution FlowTenant Resolution Flow
Request arrives → Middleware reads host header → Looks up tenant by slug or customDomain (Redis/Vercel KV cache) → Sets x-tenant-id and x-tenant-slug response headers → Layout reads headers and injects CSS variables → All Drizzle queries scope by tenantId.
Local Development — Do This First
Set LOCAL_TENANT_SLUG=soralia-village in .env.local.
Middleware falls back to this slug in development — Soralia team works entirely unchanged.
To test a new tenant: change the env var or use ngrok with a test subdomain.

2. Gaps & Issues Identified in Repository Audit2. Gaps & Issues Identified in Repository Audit
The following items were identified by comparing the original migration plan against the actual repository structure. These represent the real remaining work.
Critical GapsCritical Gaps2.1 The [lng] Route Segment Is Underdeveloped2.1 The [lng] Route Segment Is Underdeveloped
The plan places all tenant pages under [lng]/ but the actual [lng]/ folder contains only a locales/ subdirectory — no pages. All real application pages (dashboard, groups, services, etc.) live directly under src/app/ without i18n route wrapping.
Risk: Highest-Impact Change — Do Last
Moving all pages into [lng]/ touches every route and every link in the application.
RECOMMENDATION: Defer until Phases 0-3 are stable and proven.
Soralia pages stay where they are and use tenant context without the [lng]/ move for now.
Define the auth route i18n strategy before any pages move.
2.2 Auth Routes Outside the i18n Segment2.2 Auth Routes Outside the i18n Segment
sign-in, sign-up, and forgot-password live under (auth)/ with no [lng]/ wrapping. When pages eventually migrate, auth routes need their own resolution strategy — currently undefined. Decision required before the i18n migration begins.
2.3 No Systematic API Route Tenant Enforcement2.3 No Systematic API Route Tenant Enforcement
The repo has 35+ API routes. The plan says 'scope all Drizzle queries by tenantId' but provides no enforcement mechanism. Without a standard pattern, enforcement will be inconsistent and tenant data leakage becomes a real risk.
Solution — create a withTenant() helper:
// src/lib/tenant/with-tenant.ts
export async function withTenant(req: NextRequest) {
const tenantId = req.headers.get('x-tenant-id');
if (!tenantId) throw new Error('Missing tenant context');
return { tenantId };
}
Every API route handler calls this first. All Drizzle queries receive the returned tenantId as a where clause filter. This is non-negotiable before onboarding a second tenant.
2.4 TierGuard vs FeatureGate Overlap2.4 TierGuard vs FeatureGate Overlap
TierGuard.tsx already exists in src/components/ui/. The plan proposes a new FeatureGate component. These overlap and risk duplicating similar logic.
Decision required: Does FeatureGate replace TierGuard, wrap it, or do they serve genuinely distinct purposes (e.g. TierGuard = billing plan, FeatureGate = per-tenant toggle)? Document the decision before building FeatureGate.
2.5 Duplicate Locale Files2.5 Duplicate Locale Files
Translation files exist in both public/locales/ and src/app/[lng]/locales/. As multi-tenant i18n grows — especially if tenants need translation overrides — this duplication will create confusion. Consolidate to one canonical location before adding tenant-specific translation support.
2.6 /admin/platform/ vs /platform/ Ambiguity2.6 /admin/platform/ vs /platform/ Ambiguity
The plan proposes a new /platform/ route group for NetComplex marketing and super-admin. The repo already has /admin/platform/ for tenant management. Without a clear decision, both will grow in parallel and fragment the super-admin experience.
Decision required: Is /admin/platform/ the canonical super-admin UI? If so, the plan's /platform/ route group is unnecessary. Define this before building more admin features.
Component Reorganisation NoteComponent Reorganisation Note
The plan proposes reorganising ~80+ components into core/, tenant/, and custom/ folders. This is valid long-term direction but no mapping of existing components to new locations was provided. Create the mapping table (see Section 3) before moving any files. Migrate components on contact — not in a single large refactor.

3. Proposed Repository Structure3. Proposed Repository Structure
Items marked NEW are genuinely new additions. Items marked MOVE already exist and need relocating. Items marked EXISTING stay where they are and are built upon.
Key Additions to src/Key Additions to src/

i18n route segment — pages migrate here gradually (Phase 4, do last)
src/app/admin/platform/
EXISTING: super-admin tenant UI — keep building here
src/app/(auth)/
EXISTING: auth routes — i18n strategy TBD
src/components/core/
NEW: Platform-wide standardised UI, design system
src/components/tenant/
NEW: White-label aware components
src/components/custom/
NEW: Bespoke/client-specific slots
src/components/ui/TenantProvider.tsx
EXISTING — MOVE to components/tenant/
src/components/ui/TenantStyles.tsx
EXISTING — MOVE to components/tenant/
src/components/ui/TierGuard.tsx
EXISTING — reconcile with FeatureGate decision
src/lib/tenant/
NEW: Expand from existing lib/tenant.ts into a folder
src/lib/tenant/with-tenant.ts
NEW: API route enforcement helper (critical)
src/lib/features/tenantFeatures.ts
NEW: Per-tenant enabled features + config
src/types/tenant.ts
NEW: TenantConfig, FeatureDefinition types
src/middleware.ts
EXISTING — enhance for full tenant resolution + header setting
Component Destination MappingComponent Destination Mapping
Use this as a migration-on-contact guide — move a component to its new home when you next touch it.
core/layout/
Header.tsx, Footer.tsx

Shared shadcn components, Breadcrumbs, Loading, ErrorBoundary

Stay in admin/
All AdminWidget* components, ContentForm, GroupForm
Stay in dashboard/
All *Widget components until explicitly migrated to core/
Stay in services/
ServiceCard, ServicesGrid, CategoryBadge, etc.

4. Component & Feature Registry4. Component & Feature RegistryComponent RegistryComponent Registry
Centralise in src/components/registry.ts and wire into the existing WidgetRenderer.tsx:
// src/components/registry.ts
export const componentRegistry = {
'dashboard.stats': { component: StatsWidget, defaultEnabled: true },
'services.grid': { component: ServicesGrid, defaultEnabled: true },
'dashboard.agent': { component: AgentWidget, requiredPlan: 'premium' },
'dashboard.premium': { component: PremiumPortfolioWidget, requiredPlan: 'premium' },
'custom.hero': { component: BespokeHeroSlot },
} as const;
Feature RegistryFeature Registry
Extend the existing src/lib/features/registry.ts — do not replace it:
export const availableFeatures = [
{ id: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', defaultEnabled: true },
{ id: 'services-marketplace', label: 'Community Services', defaultEnabled: true },
{ id: 'bookings', label: 'Bookings', defaultEnabled: false },
{ id: 'conservation', label: 'Conservation', defaultEnabled: true },
{ id: 'premium-portfolio', label: 'Premium Seats', defaultEnabled: false },
{ id: 'directory', label: 'Directory', defaultEnabled: true },
{ id: 'groups', label: 'Groups', defaultEnabled: true },
] as const;
Per-Tenant Feature StoragePer-Tenant Feature Storage
Store feature selections in the existing tenants table:
enabledFeatures: json('enabled_features').$type<FeatureId[]>()
customConfig: json('custom_config') // bespoke settings per tenant

6. Revised Migration Phases6. Revised Migration Phases
The original phase ordering has been revised based on the repository audit. Highest-risk changes are deferred; foundational work is front-loaded.
Phase
Timing
Key Tasks
Phase 0 Foundation
This week (do first)
Set LOCAL_TENANT_SLUG=soralia-village in .env.local — unblocks Soralia dev immediately
Create withTenant() helper in src/lib/tenant/with-tenant.ts
Seed Soralia Village as tenant #1 with all features enabled and current branding values
Decide TierGuard vs FeatureGate — document the decision before building
Decide /admin/platform/ vs /platform/ — pick one canonical super-admin surface
Phase 1 Enforcement
Week 1-2
Audit all 35+ API routes — apply withTenant() to each
Wire CSS variables to tenant DB values in TenantStyles.tsx
Move TenantProvider and TenantStyles into src/components/tenant/
Build or reconcile FeatureGate — wrap toggleable routes and nav items
Consolidate duplicate locale files to one canonical location
Phase 2 Admin UI
Week 2-4
Build tenant admin UI at /admin/platform/ for feature assignment + branding upload
Add data migration script to backfill tenantId on tables that are missing it
Implement slot-based custom sections (custom_sections table + CustomSectionRenderer)
Add component registry and wire into existing WidgetRenderer
Custom domain support via Vercel API
Phase 3 Second Tenant
Week 4-6
Onboard first non-Soralia tenant via the admin UI
Test subdomain resolution end-to-end in staging
Validate feature gating — tenant with limited features sees correct UI
Enable Row Level Security (RLS) on Postgres as defense-in-depth
Load test tenant resolution caching under concurrent requests
Phase 4 i18n Migration
After Phase 3 (do last)
Define auth route i18n strategy before moving any pages
Migrate application pages from src/app/ into src/app/[lng]/ incrementally
Update all internal links and redirects
Support per-tenant translation overrides if required by a client

7. Security & Best Practices7. Security & Best Practices
Non-Negotiable Before Second Tenant Onboarding
All items below must be in place before any tenant other than Soralia is onboarded.
A data leak between tenants is a critical incident — enforce these systematically.
Tenant Isolation RulesTenant Isolation Rules
Never trust client-provided tenant IDs — always resolve from middleware headers set server-side.
withTenant() must be called at the top of every API route handler — no exceptions.
All Drizzle queries must include a tenantId where clause — use query helper wrappers to enforce this pattern.
Verify tenant membership via Better-Auth organization plugin on all authenticated actions.
Cache tenant config aggressively (Redis/Vercel KV) but invalidate on branding or feature changes.
Row Level Security (RLS)Row Level Security (RLS)
Enable RLS on all tenant-scoped tables as a defense-in-depth measure. Even if application-layer scoping has a bug, RLS prevents cross-tenant data access at the database level. Implement in Phase 3 alongside second-tenant onboarding.
Custom DomainsCustom Domains
Use the Vercel API to add custom domains programmatically when tenants configure their own domain. Validate domain ownership before activating. Ensure middleware handles the full custom domain lookup path, not just subdomain patterns.

8. Local Development Workflow8. Local Development Workflow
Default tenant
Set LOCAL_TENANT_SLUG=soralia-village in .env.local
Soralia development
No change to existing workflow — middleware resolves Soralia automatically
Test new tenant
Change env var to new slug, or use ngrok with a test subdomain
Feature testing
Use admin UI at /admin/platform/ to toggle features per tenant
DB seeding
Run seed script — ensure Soralia exists as tenant #1 before any dev work

9. Ongoing Development Conventions9. Ongoing Development Conventions
New features go into core/ or lib/features/ — never hardcoded to a specific tenant.
Tenant-specific content goes through slot-based custom sections or MDX in DB — never as code branches.
All new API routes must call withTenant() as their first operation.
All new Drizzle queries must be scoped by tenantId — use the shared query helper wrappers.
Component moves follow the mapping table in Section 3 — migrate on contact, not in bulk.
The [lng]/ route migration is out of scope until Phases 0-3 are complete and proven.
NetComplex Migration Guide • Updated April 2026 • Internal Use Only
